mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO home_project.holiday_info ( loc_date, date_name, is_holiday, date_kind ) VALUES
( #{item.locdate}, #{item.dateName}, #{item.isHoliday}, #{item.dateKind} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE date_name = VALUES(date_name), is_holiday = VALUES(is_holiday), date_kind = VALUES(date_kind)
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(loc_date, '%Y%m%d') as locdate, date_name as dateName, is_holiday as isHoliday, date_kind as dateKind FROM home_project.holiday_info WHERE loc_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate};
SELECT id, mm_user_id, name, is_deleted, created_at FROM home_project.todo_keywords WHERE name = #{name} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT k.id as keyword_id, k.mm_user_id as mm_user_id, k.name as keyword, k.is_deleted as is_deleted, k.created_at as keyword_created, t.id as task_id, t.content as content, t.status as status, t.created_at as task_created FROM home_project.todo_keywords k LEFT JOIN home_project.todo_tasks t ON k.id = t.keyword_id WHERE k.is_deleted = 0 AND (t.status = 0 OR t.status = 1 OR t.status IS NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE home_project.todo_tasks SET status = 1 - status WHERE id = #{taskId};
